title: EXPLAIN looks cheap but ANALYZE shows huge runtime from row misestimates
symptoms: Query suddenly slow after bulk load
cause: Stale or insufficient statistics cause the planner to underestimate join/filter cardinality.
solution: Run ANALYZE on affected tables; consider increasing default_statistics_target for skewed columns; rewrite queries or add appropriate indexes after measuring with EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS).
workaround: Temporary join hints are not first-class in Postgres—prefer stats and query/index fixes.
